integration_status: Local Python and CLI entry points implemented; HTTP deployment belongs to backend integration

ingest.result: true for inserted; false for identical observation ID replay; exception for conflicting IDs/windows

ingest_many.result: Atomic batch; on error the original ledger remains unchanged

state.result: Observed state at explicit timezone-aware as_of; origin required

missing_representation: No visible series for an unseen channel; channel name appears in missing_channels. An unseen device/context does not appear before its first available reading.
display_rules: Use each series context, device/source identity and units; do not merge wrist, session and overnight HR.
A stale value may be displayed with its measurement age and stale badge; do not forward-fill a new measurement or alert.
An invalid latest record has value=null; last_valid is separately identified historical data.
Assumed source clocks must be labeled retrospective timing assumptions; they cannot be described as live measured latency.
Null risk must display Unavailable, with its reasons; never replace null with 0%, low risk or an invented category.
Descriptive baseline differences are not causal triggers, clinical abnormalities or treatment recommendations.
Keep synthetic example data visibly marked as synthetic.
persistence: Append-only in-memory ledger; source replay reads saved observations. Production authentication, database durability, provenance authentication and reviewed revision handling require backend work.
metadata_verification_limit: The engine checks declared evidence tags and structure; custodians/clinical reviewers must authenticate the claims. Observation readiness never authorizes a model.
